botcomponent.description: Official Microsoft Learn documentation for Copilot Studio. This is the source for licensing and Copilot Credits: what consumes credits, how capacity is assigned to an environment, what a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence does and does not cover, and which connectors are premium. Also use it for product detail the CoE knowledge library does not cover, such as harness capabilities, connector behaviour or model availability. It describes how the product works, not how this organisation has chosen to fund or allocate it — for templates, governance and the CoE's own process, prefer the CoE knowledge library.
botcomponent.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio documentation
